title: Rough Skies (Spelunkery x Ex Deorum)
description: A datapack that integrates some Spelunkery resources into Ex Deorum
body: Rough Skies changes some sieving results from Ex Deorum to use various items from Spelunkery in place of thier vanilla counterparts. It also adds a few more results to get some Spelunkery specific items that wouldn't be available otherwise.
